name: Sunita Chaubey
summary: With over 25 years of professional experience in the UK, she has always believed in empowering women and giving back to her community. She has been working hard to promote the rich Purvanchal culture, language, and traditions.
fullText:
With over 25 years of professional experience in the UK, she has always believed in empowering women and giving back to her community.

She has been working hard to promote the rich Purvanchal culture, language, and traditions, creating platforms through cultural events where women can showcase their hidden talents and shine with confidence.

Alongside this, she takes pride in coaching, mentoring, and motivating women returning to work after career breaks, helping them rebuild confidence and achieve financial independence. She is working hard as a Recruitment Professional to support ladies get back to work after motherhood and career break.

name: Zamiha Desai MBE
summary: Zamiha Desai MBE founded RecommendAsian, an online community for British Asian women, and ProfessionalAsian, a business and professional network. She also runs the Hey Gorgeous exhibition. She was appointed MBE in the King’s Birthday Honours 2025 for services to the British Asian Community. She is based in London.

name: Ranu Mehta-Radia MBE
org: Sai School of Harrow / Diwali in London
summary: Ranu Mehta-Radia MBE founded Sai School of Harrow, a free weekend school, and has been a director of the company since 1999. She was appointed MBE in the 2026 New Year Honours for services to the community in Greater London. She has served as Creative Director of Diwali in London at Trafalgar Square.

name: Ragasudha Vinjamuri
org: Sanskruti Centre for Cultural Excellence / University of Sunderland in London
summary: Ragasudha Vinjamuri is an Associate Lecturer in the Faculty of Business and Law at the University of Sunderland in London. She founded the Sanskruti Centre for Cultural Excellence, a registered arts charity. A classical dancer, she received a British Citizen Award in 2021 and has performed Bharatanatyam in both Houses of Parliament.

name: Renu Gidoomal
summary: Renu Gidoomal is a London-based singer, songwriter and event host who sings in several languages, from bhajans to Bollywood and Sufi to soul. She leads Atmasphere Events Ltd and the fusion band Atmasphere, and has performed in more than 30 countries. She is a patron of Better Lives Foundation, a registered charity.

name: Seema Anand
summary: Seema Anand is a London-based mythologist and storyteller who specialises in women’s narratives. She lectures on the Kama Sutra and Tantric philosophy, and wrote The Arts of Seduction (Aleph Book Company, 2018). She describes herself as a Doctor of Narrative Practices and teaches storytelling in the corporate sector.

name: Lakshmi Kaul
summary: Lakshmi Kaul is CEO of Grin Media and, until recently, was Senior Vice President at Mott MacDonald. She is an Indian British National who has spent her life bringing diasporic communities closer to their cultural roots and identity.
fullText: Lakshmi Kaul is CEO of Grin Media. Until recently, she was Senior Vice President at Mott MacDonald. Kaul has had a long career across India and the United Kingdom, with several key roles including political aide to the British Member of Parliament Bob Blackman, Head of the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) in the UK, board member of the Commonwealth Enterprise and Investment Council (CWEIC), the Manchester-India Partnership, and the West Midlands-India Partnership. Lakshmi Kaul is an Indian British National who has spent her life bringing diasporic communities closer to their cultural roots and identity. She spends her time encouraging the love for nature, books, reading, reconnecting as a community and family through simple storytelling and conversation. She also curates daily wisdom stories, Authors of Bharat, re-telling stories from ancient Bharat but relevant to Modern Living, promoting thus, Indian civilisational systems. Lakshmi has had a thriving career in public policy, non-profit and corporate world before transitioning into writing and publishing full time. She spends her time living in India and United Kingdom.

name: Sonoo Malkani
summary: Sonoo Malkani has served the diverse communities of Harrow as a volunteer community leader for 49 years, working with the Local Authority, the Met Police, the London Mayor’s Office and faith groups. She has supported Met policing at a senior level for 27 years and is a former Chair of Harrow Interfaith and Harrow Carers.
fullText:
Dedicated Volunteer Community Leader, tirelessly serving diverse communities of Harrow since 49 years, collaborating with Local Authority, Met Police, London Mayor’s Office and Faith groups. Also promoting Community Cohesion & Racial harmony policing passionately helping deliver one of London’s safest boroughs.

27 years supporting challenging Met policing at Senior level.

Deeply religious former Chair Harrow Interfaith and Harrow Carers, with experienced in NHS equality issues plus awareness raising.

Fiercely patriotic Indian, equally proud Briton, adores engaging closely with and being the voice of the people to help develop trust and confidence. Loved living here since 1970. Feel privileged to serve.
